name: The Garden
source:
I meet the devil once, out in the Garden amongst the withering vines of Autumn. It use to be cold this time of year, but this is hell... and I'm in love.

[From [url=https://willagem.itch.io/the-garden]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我曾在花园里，在秋天枯萎的藤蔓之中，遇见过魔鬼一次。每年的这个时候都很冷，但这里就是地狱……而我恋爱了。

[来自[url=https://willagem.itch.io/the-garden]itch.io[/url]]
